review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: There is an argue that in school, only students with the best academic results should be rewarded, while their counterparts prefer to reward improving student. From my perspective, both types of learners should receive their own encouraging gift.

Admittedly, rewarding best individuals without any arguments is a must do thing. Initially, students who had diligently applied themselves to their studies deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards, which leads to propelling towards overall academic gains. Furthermore, this kind of competition could be seen in almost every aspect of life where only the best individuals are rewarded. Students are adapted this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, which allows them to achieve success in later life.

However, students who show improvements should also be rewarded. Only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, causing others to think that their effort is futile since they cannot surpass those outstanding individuals. Which will prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened and gradually lose the incentive to study. In addition, emphasizing improvements will encourage all students to be diligent in their studies, and helps students to understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, which irrespective of how well they have been or are performing, leads to the constant desire to outdo themselves that even benefit themselves more than competitive determination against others.
review.overall: Em đã triển khai đủ hai quan điểm và giữ được bốn chuỗi ý Cô giao, từ nỗ lực được ghi nhận đến giá trị của việc vượt chính mình. Em dùng đúng nhiều cụm của buổi học, nhưng câu thường thiếu động từ chính hoặc sai cấu trúc sau động từ nên quan hệ giữa các ý chưa rõ. Em cũng chưa viết kết bài trên trang này; bản sửa bổ sung để khẳng định lập trường thưởng cả hai nhóm. Trước khi nộp, hãy kiểm tra từng câu có chủ ngữ, động từ chính và đối tượng quy chiếu rõ hay chưa.

paragraphs: It is often believed that schools should reward students who achieve the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements. From my perspective, both groups should be rewarded equally.

Admittedly, it is justified to reward the best students. Initially, students who have diligently applied themselves to their studies deserve their praises and privileges. This may encourage these students and others to study harder to win the rewards, thereby propelling overall academic gains. Furthermore, this kind of competition could be seen in almost every aspect of life where only the best individuals are rewarded. Students are used to this reality and thrive in the face of fierce competition, which allows them to achieve success in later life.

However, students who show improvements should also be rewarded. Only a few smart students can come first and receive the rewards, causing others to think that their effort is futile since they cannot surpass those outstanding individuals. As a result, these students are prone to feeling overwhelmed and disheartened and gradually lose the incentive to study. In addition, emphasizing improvements will encourage all students to be diligent in their studies and help them understand that they need to constantly improve themselves, irrespective of how well they have been or are performing. This constant desire to outdo themselves can even benefit them more than competitive determination to win against all others.
In conclusion, schools should reward both groups: students who achieve the best academic results and students who show improvements.

task.text:
Some people think that school should reward students who show the best academic results, while others believe that it is more important to reward students who show improvements.
Discuss both views and give your own opinion.
